# Lasya Traders

> Wholesale grocery and FMCG supply for grocery retailers in Chandur, Telangana, India.

## Website
- https://lasyatradersshops.netlify.app/

## Business summary
Lasya Traders provides a client ordering portal for grocery store owners and retailers. Visitors can sign in to browse the available catalogue and submit store orders. Product availability changes with inventory.

## Product categories
- Soaps and personal care
- Chocolates and confectionery
- Snacks and biscuits
- Packaged beverages
- Household accessories and essentials

## Ordering
The website's client portal supports catalogue browsing, cart building and order submission. The checkout currently displays cash on delivery.

## Location
Chandur, Telangana, India. Contact the business through its existing channels to confirm delivery coverage.
